en-US.title: Spider mating by inserting two tentacles simultaneously 🕷️
en-US.description:
Have you ever imagined how spiders mate?

Spiders do not mate by pressing their bodies together as we might think(?).

Instead, they use their "leg guards," or tentacles.

The male first fills his tentacles with sperm, then delivers them to the female's genitals.

And surprisingly, some spiders even use two of these tentacles simultaneously.

(Subscribers showing interest)

What is the secret behind this unique method of reproduction?

[Mystery of the giant cave spider]

en-US.description:
Male spiders are often eaten by females while mating.

Therefore, they employ various tricks to survive.

Some species offer gifts, and others tie the female to buy time, but cave spiders use a completely different method.

They block the female's movements with their long legs and attempt to mate from a dangerous distance.

[Mystery of the giant cave spider]

snippet.title: 아빠 안잔다
snippet.description:
1988년, 한 학자가 중국 서부의 작은 박물관에서
믿기 힘든 얼굴과 마주합니다.
최근에 죽은 사람처럼 생긴 시신.
하지만 그는 3천 년 된 미라였습니다.

3천 년 전 사람이라고 믿기 어려울 만큼

en-US.title: How to look threatening: Open your mouth wide
en-US.description:
A lifelong single mudskipper

came out to the mudflats to find a mate for the first time in his life.

However, he happened to run into the alpha male of the area,

and a fight broke out immediately.

The mudskipper's fighting style is simple:

They face each other and open their mouths as wide as possible.

It may look trivial, but it is a threatening behavior in its own way.

But his opponent is the master of this mudflat.

In the end, the young one couldn't hold out and left.

It is the moment the dream of the first romance of the single mudskipper vanishes.

[Animal Fight Club 3]

id.title: Cara terlihat mengancam: Buka mulutmu lebar-lebar
id.description:
Seekor ikan lumpur jantan yang hidup sendirian seumur hidupnya

keluar ke dataran lumpur untuk mencari pasangan untuk pertama kalinya dalam hidupnya.

Namun, ia bertemu dengan pejantan alfa di daerah tersebut,

dan perkelahian pun segera terjadi.

Gaya bertarung ikan lumpur itu sederhana:

Mereka saling berhadapan dan membuka mulut selebar mungkin.

Mungkin terlihat sepele, tetapi itu adalah perilaku yang mengancam dengan caranya sendiri.

Namun lawannya adalah penguasa dataran lumpur ini.

Pada akhirnya, si muda tidak mampu bertahan dan pergi.

Saat itulah mimpi percintaan pertama ikan lumpur jantan itu sirna.

[Animal Fight Club 3]

en-US.title: A small predator with a heart rate of 1,200 beats per minute that dies of starvation
en-US.description:
It may look like an ordinary rat, but the Northern Short-tailed Shrew is one of the most brutal predators on Earth.

If it doesn't consume three times its body weight in a day, it could die within hours.

That is why it hunts without rest.

Its heart beats 1,200 times per minute, and it even ventures onto the dangerous surface to find prey.

snippet.title: 흡혈박쥐가 들키지 않고 피를 마시는 방법
snippet.description:
포유류 가운데 50종 중 1종은 박쥐입니다.
하지만 모든 박쥐가 같은 건 아닙니다.
과일을 먹는 날여우도 있지만,
어둠 속에서 진짜 사냥꾼은 따로 있죠.

흡혈박쥐는 초음파로 먹잇감을 찾고,
조용히 땅을 기어 다가가 면도날 같은 이빨로
피부에 아주 작은 상처를 냅니다. 

엄지손가락만 한 작은 몸집,
하지만 한 무리가 1년이면 말 수십 마리의 피를 마십니다.

en-US.title: How vampire bats drink blood without being detected
en-US.description:
One in 50 mammal species is a bat.

However, not all bats are the same.

While there are fruit-eating flying foxes,

the true hunters in the dark are something else entirely.

Vampire bats locate their prey using ultrasound,

and approach silently by crawling across the ground,

making tiny cuts in the skin with their razor-sharp teeth.

With a body no bigger than a thumb,

a single colony drinks the blood of dozens of horses in a year.

[Incredible Bats]

snippet.title: 굶주린 사자에게 잡힌 기린의 운명은?
snippet.description:
아프리카 초원에서 가장 눈에 띄는 동물, 기린.
키는 최대 6m, 초원의 대부분 동물을
내려다보는 거인입니다.

기린 곁에서 위험을 먼저 알아챌 수 있죠.

en-US.title: What is the fate of the giraffe caught by a hungry lion?
en-US.description:
The giraffe, the most striking animal on the African savanna.

Standing up to 6 meters tall, it is a giant that looks down on most of the animals in the grasslands.

Thanks to this, other herbivores can detect danger first when a giraffe is nearby.

However, even this giant has predators it is wary of.

A cornered mother giraffe does not run away.

She fights back, delivering powerful kicks with her long legs.

[The Great Secret of Survival of the Giraffe (Giraffe African Giant)]
